subject: Obstruction - East Coast - Cap Cove,Trinity Bay
text:
Obstruction - East Coast - Cap Cove,Trinity Bay
The aquaculture site in Cap Cove, Trinity Bay has been identified as a potential hazard to navigation due to lack of perimeter markings and  partially submerged unmarked buoys.
The aquaculture site is located in approximate position 48 22,808N 053 22,634W.

Caution.
